purpose: N1 operation policy plus N2 canonical policy readbacks for owner applicability; partial GPT-native reasoning input, NOT full model output

N1.query: SELECT statement_timestamp() AS observed_at,operation_code,policy_role,policy_code,policy_version,policy_sha FROM public.v_lf_operation_policy_snapshot WHERE operation_code='ORQUESTACION_PIPELINE_LF' ORDER BY policy_role,policy_code

N2.query: SELECT statement_timestamp() AS observed_at,policy_code,policy_version,status,source_ref,policy_sha FROM public.lf_policy_versions WHERE status='ACTIVE' AND (policy_code ILIKE '%OWNER%' OR policy_code ILIKE '%ASSET%' OR policy_code ILIKE '%CUSTOD%' OR policy_code ILIKE '%SUPER%') ORDER BY policy_code,policy_version LIMIT 30

N2_SCOPE.query: SELECT statement_timestamp() AS observed_at,policy_code,policy_version,status,source_ref,policy_sha FROM public.lf_policy_versions WHERE status='ACTIVE' AND (policy_payload::text ILIKE '%ACT-0058%' OR policy_payload::text ILIKE '%owner_name%' OR policy_payload::text ILIKE '%SUPER_ADMIN%') ORDER BY policy_code,policy_version LIMIT 30

ASSET_N1.query: SELECT statement_timestamp() AS observed_at,codigo_activo,nombre_canonico,owner_name,estado_documental,estado_operativo FROM public.v_lf_fuente_operativa_busqueda WHERE codigo_activo='ACT-0058'

ASSET_N2.query: SELECT statement_timestamp() AS observed_at,codigo_activo,nombre_canonico,owner_name,estado_documental,estado_operativo FROM public.lf_activos WHERE codigo_activo='ACT-0058'
